project.description:
Load Flank Seq
MANUAL ONLY (ZFIN-10486): this job no longer runs on a schedule -- its cron entry in trigger.production.properties is commented out. It recomputes flanking sequence in place, and an unattended nightly run is how a stale GRCz11-derived value silently overwrote a correct GRCz12tu one. Run it by hand to act on what Check-Flanking-Sequence-Drift_w reports.
Set environment variable FORCE_FULL_UPDATE to true to force a full update of the flank seq data. Set FEATURE_ZDBID to a feature ID to run for a single feature only. Without FORCE_FULL_UPDATE it only processes data modified in the last 48 hours, which is of limited use now that the job is triggered by hand rather than nightly.
INCLUDE_SANGER (ZFIN-10486): "sa" (Sanger allele) features are excluded by default -- they are ~36,000 of the ~42,000 rows, so including them makes a full run roughly 6.6x bigger (6,362 features vs 41,914). Check this box together with FORCE_FULL_UPDATE to also recompute them against their current-assembly location, which is what a backfill of the Check-Flanking-Sequence-Drift_w report needs. Flanking sequence that was submitted rather than computed (the Sanger ZMP data submission) is skipped either way and cannot be overwritten by any combination of these options.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: FEATURE_ZDBID
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Leave blank for default logic. If specified, will only apply changes to the given feature

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: FORCE_FULL_UPDATE
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: Check this option to run a full update. Otherwise, it only runs through changes from the last 48 hours.

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: INCLUDE_SANGER
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: Check this option (with FORCE_FULL_UPDATE) to also recompute "sa" (Sanger allele) features. Leave unchecked for normal runs.
